groups.rationale: Antithesis workload image now links /opt/antithesis/catalog to the copied selection-scoped workload module tree (one instrumentor root) instead of a real directory the hosted instrumentor split into one root per package, of which the Python SDK registered only one per process; 17-reference.md documents that every selected assertion now registers in every workload process and that an unreached selected assertion appears as a zero-example property, with the multi-path "Paths found" signal as the regression indicator. identity.py freeze refuses a rootfs without that single link. Harness identity tooling only; no production behavior change.
